## Executive Summary

Extensive experience delivering large-scale BigTech and Enterprise systems across FinTech, E-Commerce, and corporate AI, alongside launching independent tech products. Owns Full-Stack architecture and System Design aligned with business requirements (Monorepo, BFF, Micro-frontends, DDD, Hexagonal, Event-Driven), integrating web applications, cross-platform mobile (Flutter for iOS & Android), and backend services into a unified platform.

Provides technical leadership and business-to-engineering alignment: managing development teams, enforcing engineering standards, and scaling delivery workflows with AI agents (Agentic Factories, Harness, Context & Graph Engineering, Spec-Driven Development) to accelerate Time-to-Market while maintaining strict control over architecture and code security.
